export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$JEDI_LIBS:$MKLROOT/lib/intel64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
export MPICH_OFI_STARTUP_CONNECT=1

#clt test the "file not found" issue
F="/lfs/h2/emc/da/noscrub/Ting.Lei/dr-NA-Ens3Dvar-MGBF/fv3_2024052700_nadomain/data/bkg/20240527.010000.coupler.res"
TARGET="$(readlink -f "$F")"
mpiexec -n 32 bash -lc "hostname; ls -l '$F' || echo FAIL_link; ls -l '$TARGET' || echo FAIL_target" | sort





# make sure mpiexec propagates env (Hydra/PALS understands -env or -genv):
mpiexec -n 1936 -ppn 32 --cpu-bind core --depth 4 --label \
  -env LD_LIBRARY_PATH "$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" \
  $EXEC \
   deb-ens3dvar-dual-vdl_v1-node62-p1936.yaml  deb-ens3dvar-dual-vdl_v1-node62-p1936.out
exit
